segments.name: chemical manufacturing
segments.description: Integrated chemical manufacturing segment supplying nylon solutions, plant nutrients and chemical intermediates to customers in construction, fertilizer, agrochemical, plastics, packaging and coatings end markets.
segments.evidence: The Company has concluded that it is a single operating segment and a single reportable segment: chemical manufacturing.

revenueModel.text: Customers in building and construction, fertilizers, agrochemicals, plastics, solvents, packaging, paints, coatings and adhesives pay AdvanSix for nylon solutions, plant nutrients and chemical intermediates.
revenueModel.evidence: The chemical manufacturing segment derives its revenues by innovating and delivering essential products in the industries of nylon solutions, plant nutrients, and chemical intermediates to its customers in a wide variety of end markets and applications, such as building and construction, fertilizers, agrochemicals, plastics, solvents, packaging, paints, coatings, adhesives and electronics.
